rule: Rule, fixed before the draw: from the 1,000-package VinDr-CXR store (the seed-0 sample of the Kaggle training set converted on 2026-09-06), take every package that (a) was never shown to a model in any benchmark run, never in the reader study and never in the marker review, (b) carries inferred L/R edge labels, (c) has the stored anatomy masks and passes the pixel-side orientation check with a clear cardiac cue (bench/tasks.py clear_cue, confidence >= 0.9, offset >= 5 % of thoracic width: the same gate as round 3a), and (d) has a canonical render. Shuffle-sample 90 of them with random.Random(SEED); the first N_SET are the set, the remaining ones are the reserve, used in order only for the technical replacements named in the pre-registration.
